phase_title: 実測入力データの完全性・署名・整合検証設計
phase_purpose: Phase 16 実測入力データエントリ受領・検証層：Phase 16-1 で受領したデータの完全性（すべての必須フィールド存在）、署名・認証、データ間整合性を検証する設計
execution_context: reports-only design phase; design of validation rules and procedures only, no actual validation execution yet

governance.safety_rule: All blocked_actions remain strictly prohibited. Data validation is design-only; no actual validation processing occurs until Phase 16-2 design is approved. No app/tests implementation permitted.
governance.hard_stop_condition: This phase is design-only. No actual data validation or modification is permitted.

validation_design_overview.validation_purpose: Verify that Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 human review input data are complete, authentic, and consistent before proceeding to Phase 16-3 update feasibility assessment
validation_triggers: Phase 16-1 receipt record created with Phase 15-1 data received
Phase 16-1 receipt record created with Phase 15-2 data received
validation_input_sources: Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 format specifications (for reference)
validation_design_overview.validation_output: Phase 16-2 validation report certifying data completeness, signature validity, and consistency—or rejection with reasons

completeness_validation_design.completeness_validation_purpose: Confirm all required fields from Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 are present and non-empty

phase_15_1_required_fields.requirement: Must be non-empty, valid reviewer identifier
phase_15_1_required_fields.validation_rule: Check presence and length > 0; verify against reviewer registry if available
Parse as datetime; verify timestamp is within reasonable bounds (not future, not before Phase 15 approval)
Check value is one of allowed enum values; case-sensitive

phase_15_1_required_fields.requirement: Must reference evidence from Phase 14 or Phase 15 layers
phase_15_1_required_fields.validation_rule: Non-empty array; each reference must be validly formatted

phase_15_1_required_fields.requirement: Reviewer must express confidence level in decision
phase_15_1_required_fields.validation_rule: Check value is one of allowed enum values

phase_15_1_required_fields.requirement: Signature or token proving reviewer identity and commitment
phase_15_1_required_fields.validation_rule: Verify signature matches reviewer_id; check signature algorithm and timestamp

phase_15_2_required_fields.requirement: Must be non-empty, valid reviewer identifier
phase_15_2_required_fields.validation_rule: Check presence and length > 0; verify against reviewer registry
Parse as datetime; verify timestamp is within reasonable bounds
Check value is one of allowed enum values; case-sensitive
Non-empty; must explain basis for permission judgment

phase_15_2_required_fields.requirement: Must reference evidence from Phase 14 or Phase 15 layers
phase_15_2_required_fields.validation_rule: Non-empty array; each reference must be validly formatted

phase_15_2_required_fields.requirement: Signature or token proving reviewer identity and commitment
phase_15_2_required_fields.validation_rule: Verify signature matches reviewer_id; check signature algorithm and timestamp

step_1_field_presence_check.action: For each required field, check that field exists in data payload
step_1_field_presence_check.condition: Field must be present (key exists in JSON or CSV row)
step_1_field_presence_check.fail_action: Record missing fields and mark validation as FAILED_INCOMPLETE

step_2_field_value_non_empty_check.action: For each present field, check that value is non-empty (not null, not empty string, not empty array)
step_2_field_value_non_empty_check.fail_action: Record empty fields and mark validation as FAILED_INCOMPLETE

step_3_field_type_and_format_check.action: For each field, verify value conforms to declared type (string, ISO8601, enum, array, object, etc.)
step_3_field_type_and_format_check.condition: Value must match field type specification
step_3_field_type_and_format_check.pass_criterion: All field values match declared types
step_3_field_type_and_format_check.fail_action: Record type mismatches and mark validation as FAILED_FORMAT

signature_and_authentication_validation_.signature_validation_purpose: Verify that reviewer identity and commitment are cryptographically proven by signature

signature_components_to_verify.verification_type: Digital signature (RSA, ECDSA, etc.) OR authentication token (JWT, OAuth, etc.)
signature_components_to_verify.requirement: Signature must cryptographically bind reviewer_id and timestamp to data payload

signature_components_to_verify.verification_type: Verify algorithm is approved (e.g., RSA-2048+, ECDSA-256+, SHA-256 or stronger)
signature_components_to_verify.requirement: Weak algorithms (MD5, SHA-1, RSA-1024) must fail validation

signature_components_to_verify.verification_type: Retrieve reviewer's public key or certificate from registry
signature_components_to_verify.requirement: Key must be valid, not revoked, not expired

option_1_digital_signature.method: Cryptographic signature (e.g., reviewer signs data with private key)
verification_steps: Extract reviewer's public key from registry
Verify signature against data payload (all required fields) using public key
Verify signature timestamp matches or precedes data submission timestamp

option_2_jwt_or_oauth_token.method: JWT or OAuth token issued by identity provider
verification_steps: Decode token (without verification) to extract claims
Verify token signature using identity provider's public key
Verify token claims include reviewer_id matching data payload
Verify token was issued recently (iat claim) before data submission
option_2_jwt_or_oauth_token.pass_criterion: Token verification succeeds and claims match

option_3_multi_factor_authentication_rec.method: Evidence that reviewer authenticated via MFA (email confirmation, SMS, TOTP, etc.)
verification_steps: Query MFA record for reviewer_id at timestamp
Verify MFA challenge was completed successfully
Verify MFA timestamp matches data submission window

step_1_signature_field_presence.action: Check that reviewer_signature_or_authentication field exists and is non-empty

step_2_signature_algorithm_check.action: Decode or inspect signature to determine algorithm used
step_2_signature_algorithm_check.pass_criterion: Algorithm is in approved list (RSA-2048+, ECDSA-256+, etc.)

step_3_reviewer_key_or_token_issuer_veri.action: Retrieve reviewer's public key/certificate or identity provider's key
step_3_reviewer_key_or_token_issuer_veri.pass_criterion: Key is valid, not revoked, not expired

step_4_signature_or_token_verification.action: Cryptographically verify signature/token using appropriate method

step_5_timestamp_coherence.action: Verify signature/token timestamp is before data submission timestamp

consistency_validation_design.consistency_validation_purpose: Verify that Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 data are mutually consistent and do not contradict each other

consistency_checks.check_description: Both Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 should be from the same reviewer OR from coordinated reviewers
consistency_checks.rule_option_1: Same reviewer: reviewer_id must be identical in both data payloads
consistency_checks.rule_option_2: Different reviewers: both must be authorized; timestamps must be within acceptable time window (e.g., within 1 hour)
consistency_checks.pass_criterion: Reviewer identities are consistent per selected rule

consistency_checks.check_description: Phase 15-2 timestamp should not significantly predate Phase 15-1 timestamp
consistency_checks.rule: Phase 15-2 timestamp should be >= Phase 15-1 timestamp (reviewer makes decision on integrated_decision first, then permission)
consistency_checks.pass_criterion: Phase 15-2 timestamp >= Phase 15-1 timestamp OR within acceptable skew window

consistency_checks.check_description: If integrated_decision = NO_GO, then receiver_validator_permission MUST be NOT_EFFECTIVE
consistency_checks.rule: IF Phase 15-1 integrated_decision = 'NO_GO' THEN Phase 15-2 permission_judgment MUST = 'NOT_EFFECTIVE'

consistency_checks.check_description: Supporting evidence referenced in both should not contradict each other
consistency_checks.rule: Both Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 supporting_evidence_references should refer to compatible evidence sets; cross-reference for contradictions

consistency_checks.check_description: Confidence level should match judgment certainty
consistency_checks.rule: If reviewer expresses HIGH confidence, judgment should be definitive (not ambiguous); LOW confidence may indicate need for re-review
consistency_checks.pass_criterion: Confidence assessment is reasonable given judgment
consistency_checks.fail_action: Mark consistency as WARN_CONFIDENCE_MISMATCH (not hard fail, but flag for Phase 16-3)

step_1_reviewer_identity_check.action: Compare reviewer_id from Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 payloads
step_1_reviewer_identity_check.pass_criterion: Identities match or are authorized pair

step_2_timestamp_order_check.action: Compare reviewer_timestamp from Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2

step_3_decision_logic_coherence_check.action: IF Phase 15-1 integrated_decision = 'NO_GO' THEN verify Phase 15-2 permission_judgment = 'NOT_EFFECTIVE'

step_4_evidence_reference_compatibility_.action: Review supporting_evidence_references in both payloads; check for contradictions

step_5_confidence_judgment_alignment_che.action: Review confidence_assessment in context of decision judgment
step_5_confidence_judgment_alignment_che.fail_action: Mark validation as WARN_CONFIDENCE_MISMATCH (flag but not hard fail)

phase_16_1_receipt_record_reference.requirement: Reference to Phase 16-1 receipt record that triggered this validation

elements.phase_15_1_field_check_results: List of fields checked, present/absent status
elements.phase_15_2_field_check_results: List of fields checked, present/absent status
elements.missing_fields_list: If INCOMPLETE, which fields are missing
elements.type_mismatch_fields_list: If any fields have type mismatches

elements.phase_15_1_signature_verification_method: Digital signature / JWT / MFA record / etc.
elements.phase_15_2_signature_verification_method: Digital signature / JWT / MFA record / etc.
elements.any_signature_failures: List of signature check failures with reasons

consistency_validation_result.description: Overall consistency check result (INCONSISTENT = hard fail; WARNING = review recommended)

elements.reviewer_identity_coherence: Same reviewer / different authorized pair / MISMATCH
elements.any_consistency_failures: List of consistency check failures with details

overall_validation_result.logic: PASSED_VALIDATION: all three check types (completeness, authentication, consistency) PASSED. FAILED: any category FAILED. PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS: all pass but consistency has warnings.

recommended_action.logic: PROCEED if PASSED_VALIDATION. REQUEST_RESUBMISSION if FAILED_INCOMPLETE. ESCALATE or HOLD if FAILED_AUTHENTICATION or FAILED_INCONSISTENCY.

validation_workflow.trigger: Phase 16-1 creates receipt record with data payloads

step_1_initiate_validation.action: Phase 16-2 validation system triggered by receipt completion
step_1_initiate_validation.input: Phase 16-1 receipt record ID and data payload references

step_5_overall_determination.action: Synthesize results into validation_final_status and next_step_recommendation

step_6_report_storage_and_notification.action: Store validation report in reports/; notify appropriate parties of outcome

depends_on: Phase 16-1: Actual measurement input data entry receipt design and execution
Phase 15-1: integrated_decision input format specification (for validation rules)
Phase 15-2: receiver_validator_permission input format specification (for validation rules)
feeds_into: Phase 16-3: Pre-decision update feasibility assessment (receives validated data and report)

design_review_checklist: Completeness validation checks all required fields from Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2
Field type and format validation is specified for each required field
Signature validation procedure supports multiple authentication methods (digital sig, JWT, MFA)
Signature algorithm verification includes weak algorithm rejection
Consistency checks verify reviewer identity, timestamps, decision logic, and evidence compatibility
Confidence-judgment alignment is checked as warning (not hard fail)
Overall validation result logic clearly defines pass/fail criteria
Validation report structure captures all check results and findings
Recommended actions flow logically from validation outcomes
All blocked actions remain in governance

completion_gate.gate_condition: Validation design approved AND validation rules finalized AND validation procedure workflow reviewed
completion_gate.approval_required: Human technical reviewer + Phase 16 design authority
completion_gate.prerequisite_for: Phase 16-3 can begin once validation design is approved and Phase 16-1 receipt process starts producing validated data
